subject.title: [Feature]: Add runtime testing for skill workshop proposals before apply

question: Should Skill Workshop add pre-apply runtime validation, and should the MVP stop at load/schema validation or include sandboxed invocation and side-effect checks?
rationale: The request is useful but executing or simulating pending generated skills before approval changes the security boundary and needs maintainer intent on sandboxing, tool policy, and test oracle ownership.

options.title: Staged core MVP
options.body: Add load/discovery/schema validation and proposal health status first, with invocation skipped unless safe representative input is explicitly available.

options.title: Full sandboxed runtime tests
options.body: Design a stronger sandboxed invocation contract now, including allowed tools, network/filesystem policy, expected outputs, and allowed side effects.

options.title: Defer to lifecycle contract
options.body: Keep this issue open but make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98002 decide the validation contract before any runtime-test implementation starts.

recommendation.title: Staged core MVP
recommendation.body: Add load/discovery/schema validation and proposal health status first, with invocation skipped unless safe representative input is explicitly available.

likelyOwner.reason: shakkernerd introduced the central Skill Workshop proposal store, CLI, Gateway, and agent-tool surfaces that would need to share the validation contract.
